component.name: VLC Redesign
component.summary: Unofficial VLC-style media player with Juxtopposed's design

description.p: The number 1 best build with the design of Juxtopposed: a modern media player made from the VLC redesign in the video "I Redesigned VLC After 25 Years". It plays with VLC's own engine (libVLC).

ul.li: Library with folders, playlists, recently played and where you left off
Subtitles (also from OpenSubtitles) and synced lyrics
Equalizer, audio and video effects, A-B repeat, chapters and bookmarks
DVD menus, network streams, recording and snapshots
Light, dark and system theme with accent colors, in 8 languages

description.p: Unofficial fan project, not made by or affiliated with VideoLAN. "VLC" and the cone logo are trademarks of VideoLAN.
